description: Canonical Run event vocabulary shared by the Docker (FastAPI) and Desktop (Rust) editions. Every kind in `shared` must be emitted with the same spelling by both engines. A kind that exists in only one edition is listed explicitly with the reason, so adding one forces a deliberate decision instead of silent drift. Checked by scripts/check-run-event-parity.py.

docker_only.approval: Docker emits one approval event for a tool that needs a decision; Desktop splits the same step into tool_approval_requested/tool_approval_resolved.
docker_only.browser_frame: Docker streams browser screenshots from the containerised Playwright runner. Desktop's live browser view is a separate Tauri command/event, not a run event.
docker_only.model_rerouted: Docker's Auto routing can reroute a live Run; Desktop chooses its Auto model before the Run starts.
docker_only.phase_advanced: Docker's verification loop advances the plan phase. Desktop reports verification through verification_required/verification_failed only.
docker_only.plan: Docker emits `plan` when the update_plan tool runs; Desktop's checklist uses todo_list instead.

desktop_only.destructive_tool_called: Desktop records the warning shown before a destructive tool. Docker asks for approval instead of emitting a separate event.
desktop_only.error: Desktop surfaces provider/engine failures as a dedicated event; Docker ends the Run with status=failed and a status event.
desktop_only.format_applied: Desktop records the post-edit formatter result. Docker's formatting runs as an ordinary tool call and is folded into tool_result.
desktop_only.replay_truncated: Desktop's replay window marker (MAX_REPLAY_EVENTS). The Docker SSE stream resumes from Last-Event-ID instead of truncating.
desktop_only.steering_applied: Desktop records an injected steering instruction as its own event. Docker has no steering event today.
desktop_only.todo_list: Desktop's agent checklist. Docker emits `plan` when update_plan runs.
desktop_only.tool_approval_requested: Desktop's request half of an approval; Docker emits the single `approval` kind.
desktop_only.tool_approval_resolved: Desktop's resolution half of an approval; Docker emits the single `approval` kind.
desktop_only.tool_denied: Desktop emits a dedicated denial event; Docker returns a tool_result carrying error/code `tool_denied`.
desktop_only.verification_failed: Desktop emits a failed verification. Docker reports verification_required/stagnation_detected plus the terminal status instead.
